name: sphrs1
label: Number of hrs spouse worked last week

questions.text:
Last week was your (wife/husband) working full time, part time, going to school, keeping house, or what?
 A. IF WORKING, FULL OR PART TIME:  How many hours did (he/she) work last week, at all jobs?
questions.stem: Last week was your (wife/husband) working full time, part time, going to school, keeping house, or what?
questions.item: A. IF WORKING, FULL OR PART TIME:  How many hours did (he/she) work last week, at all jobs?

name: spevwork
label: Spouse ever work as long as a year

questions.text:
Last week was your (wife/husband) working full time, part time, going to school, keeping house, or what?
 C. IF RETIRED, IN SCHOOL, KEEPING HOUSE, OR OTHER:  Did (he/she) ever work for as long as one year?
